answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 4061 Country: Bangladesh Title: How should a deceased be buried inside the grave? Only face or the whole body towards the Kiblah? Question: Assalamu-Alaikum, How should a deceased be buried inside the grave? Only face or the whole body towards the Kiblah? Zazakallahu-khairan..... Answer ID: 4061 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 916/702=H) Not only the face, but leaning the entire body facing qiblah is sunnah . It has been clarified in the books of fiqh and fatwas . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
